items.t: Boeing Is Down 37% From Its High, and Its Jet Unit Is in an “Overstaffed Position.” Is the Selling Overdone?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysBoeing just hit a fresh 52-week low, 37% below its January high, because its 737 production ramp keeps slipping and its cash targets keep moving to later years. A 5% cut to its jet workforce and lower October deliveries show the slower ramp is real, and it also matters for engine maker GE Aerospace and for Southwest Airlines, which flies only 737s.

items.sum: A trial court sided with the estate and ordered the ex-wife to hand over the money. Then an appeals panel scolded both sets of lawyers for missing a federal rule that has stood for decades. Whose name is on your form?
